obligations.note: The new branch in app.py `match()` serves GET /compat/account-number/{id} outside ROUTE_TABLE. It builds an ad-hoc Route for the privileged action `view_account_number` with mfa=False, so an account number is revealed without MFA through a route not in the table. The routes control test only enumerates the route table, so its pass (and ledger entry ACR-0404, which covers routes.py) does not reach this path.
The change deviates from MFA-1 without a valid exception. The only MFA-1 exception, EXC-0172, is withdrawn and scoped to mortgage.routes, not payments.http.

Ticket CHG-25143 is standard and was approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-09-29, before review. Its components (payments.http) cover the only touched path, apps/baseline-payments/payments/app.py.
Mara Costa, a change_approver for payments and not the author (Aisha Bello), gave a code_review approval.
Both approvals name the head commit 682c1da1, which is the only commit in the change.

run.json reports success on the head commit from ci-runner-08 on 2026-10-01. The attached JUnit report is inconsistent with it: it is timestamped 2026-10-23, after the review time, from host dev-laptop-7.local. The report therefore cannot be tied to this CI run, even though it lists the MFA-1 control test as passing.
app.py is security_sensitive (payments.http). Kofi Mensah, a security_reviewer, approved the head commit.
No protected paths (controls/, control tests, ci/) are touched, so no control_owner approval is needed.
No ledger entry covers app.py. The code covered by ACR-0401 to ACR-0406 (routes.py, payments.py, audit.py and the mortgage files) is unchanged, so no accepted evidence lapses.

summary: The change adds a hard-coded compatibility URL that bypasses the route table and serves the privileged account-number reveal with mfa=False. This directly violates MFA-1, and no valid exception covers it. The process records (ticket, code review, security review) are in order, but the CI test report cannot be tied to the recorded run, and the passing routes control test does not reach routes served outside the table. The change is rejected.
